content.text: Clear picture: errors are `PaymentProviderFailed: api.io-pay.example returned 503`, latency spiked massively (p50 from ~45ms to ~2044ms), no deployments in the past week, and io-pay is a third-party dependency owned by IO Payments Ltd. This is an upstream dependency failure.

hypotheses.subject: api.io-pay.example
hypotheses.summary: io-shop's account page calls the third-party payment provider io-pay (api.io-pay.example) to fetch card details; that provider began returning HTTP 503 at 17:58, driving io-shop's error rate to 100% and p50/p95/p99 latency up by ~40x as requests waited on the failing calls before failing. No deployment or config change occurred on io-shop in the preceding week, ruling out a code or config cause on this service.

supporting_evidence.claim: ERROR io-shop: account page request failed - PaymentProviderFailed: api.io-pay.example returned 503 for /v1/shoppers/shopper-19845-4-0/card at src/io_shop/payment_provider.py:96
WARN io-shop: account page error rate at 100.00% over the last minute
io-pay: third-party, owned by IO Payments Ltd, at api.io-pay.example - Holds the card Io charges. Called while the account page renders, because Io has never stored a card number
